cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader, making the principal's access to ALL tables in database r0 explicit rather than implicit. Previously the reader had access only to bundle_fields (140 rows). With the explicit grant, bundle-builder reads 280 rows (from all tables in r0), exceeding worker-runtime.max_entries=200, causing worker-runtime.exit_code=2 and refusal to start.
